name: THADDEUS GRUBB
note: Doc 17 v2 beat 4, verbatim. The first interaction in the game is a dialogue choice, which teaches the whole system before the player has taken a step. All three lead to the same place and differ only in emphasis. Nobody is listening to any of them -- Thad says it to a road. None is tagged [COMIC]: they are not jokes, they are the same deadpan register three ways, and the check that wants one [COMIC] per node is allowed to be told so here.

options.text: My name is Thaddeus Grubb. I have four dollars, a letter of introduction to a man who is dead, and a very good ear.
My name is Thaddeus Grubb. I have come out here to become rich, and I have four dollars.
My name is Thaddeus Grubb. I tune pianos. There is, I am told, no call for it here.
